source.title: Armagh Guardian, 2 May 1902, p. 2 ("But Few Contests": county council nominations, with labels); members confirmed by the Lurgan Times, 7 June 1902, p. 3 ("Armagh County Council": complete list of the elected members)
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names and labels read from the page images; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1902: polled 28 May 1902 in six divisions; the other fifteen divisions (seventeen seats) were returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
